comment: Great professor. Super easy class if you take notes

I am a leadership major, and taking this class as my first leadership course made me even more excited to stick with my major! Olga is witty, not afraid to speak against the status quo, and extremely knowledgeable in her field. She is fascinating, a fair grader, and really respects you if she can tell you are putting in the work. Highly recommend!

Her class is super engaging, and she always facilitates interesting discussions. There are "pop quizzes", but they are multiple choice with pretty obvious answers just to make sure you read. She is such a sweetheart, would absolutely recommend!

If you're interested in Leadership, Professor Chykina is a great professor. She is caring and does her best to get to know all her students. There is a lot of reading, 20-50 pages per lecture, but as long as you get the general idea, you will be prepared for a pop quiz. Open book tests and 1 short paper. Make sure you participate in class

She is super sweet and wants all of students to succeed. She is accessible outside of class and is always open to answer any questions you have. There is a good amount of reading but it's not too difficult and I found it very interesting. Good stuff to know and learn about. She also teaches it well

Dr. Chykina is an amazing professor. There are a few pop quizzes, but they are easy as long as you have skimmed the reading. The final and midterm are very important in determining your overall grade, but they are both open note. There is a reading due every class, sometimes they are long but for the most part you only need to know the main ideas.

Prof. Chykina is a solid professor whose 102 class is approachable and well-structured. She is engaged and invested in her students' learning, though the content, focusing on gender biases and social issues, can feel cursory at times. Discussions often center on key points from lengthy readings. While occasionally monotonous, I'd recommend for 102.
She is such a sweet person and an engaging prof. Directions for assignments are always clear and concise. Papers are not too long and the tests were open book and pretty easy.

She is really nice but the class is super boring. She tends to emphasize one side of the political aisle over the other when the class has really nothing to do with politics. The class itself isn't hard but if you don't want to be bored maybe take another prof.

Professor Chykina is caring for her students and is very interested in the subject she teaches. She loves to hear students opinions and if you participate in class you will do fine. Few assignments where most of your grade depends on the midterm and final which you are well prepared for if you attend class.

Dr. Chykina cares about our well-being and is always accessible after class to help. The reading materials can be a bit long or tough, but Dr. Chykina organizes interesting class activities to help us understand the concepts. You are welcome to discuss anything with her (either coursework or life in general), can't ask for more!
Nothing bad to say, very average professor. She is a little unforgiving though

Professor Chykina was awesome. Yes, the LDST 102 course was a little more case-study/article-heavy than I was expecting having come from 101, but she was a reasonable, nice grader, and was encouraging of class discussion. I look forward to having her in the next Jepson course as she is positive and well-versed. P.S. Open-note midterm and final!

Dr.Volha is a wonderful professor! She is lecture heavy, but the lectures are basically discussions of the readings, so always do them otherwise class is awkward. Fair grader, easy writing assignments, and loves student participation.

Dr. Chykina is an incredible person both inside and outside the classroom. She brings energy to the students all the time. Always willing to discuss with you on anythings, your study or your life. Can't ask for more!

Dr. Chykina is wonderful professor, very intelligent, and fair . Breakdown of the class- we have topics and specific readings for each- 1 write-up per topic. The readings can be pretty long at first but you get used to them. Participation is important because we discuss things more in-depth. Midterm and final- open book and very straightforward.

Dr Chykina's lectures are interesting and she really cares for her students. All you have to do is read one 15ish page research paper a night and then discuss it in class with only seven 1.5 page reading responses. The midterm was also very easy, however, I have still learned a lot.

Professor Chykina is sweet and cares about her students. After class, I would often stay and talk to her after class because she was very friendly and approachable. Her feedback was very helpful and the course material was very interesting. Participation does matter and she does her best to call on everyone. I would recommend her to anyone.

Chykina is a real gem. I knew nothing about quantitative social science before taking her class, but she really walks you through it all and is willing to help outside of class. She also took the time to adjust her curriculum to how our class was doing, which is especially appreciated. One of my favorite Jepson profs for sure!
